title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 91
description: Ten questions on Psalms 91: rest in the shadow of the Almighty, protection under his wings, and his promise to answer.

questions.text: Where will the one who dwells in the secret place of the Most High rest?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

answers.text: In the shade of the mountains
In the courts of the temple
In the shadow of the Almighty
In the cleft of a great rock

questions.text: Verse 2 says of Yahweh, "He is my refuge and my..." what?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust."

questions.text: From whose snare will he deliver you?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler.

questions.text: With what will he cover you, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge."

questions.text: What "by day" will you not be afraid of?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says you shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day.

answers.text: The arrow that flies by day
The sun that burns by day
The lion that roars by day
The sword of the enemy by day

questions.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand where?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand.

questions.text: Whom will he put in charge of you to guard you in all your ways?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways."

questions.text: Which animals will you tread on, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "You will tread on the lion and cobra."

questions.text: Why will God deliver him, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: "Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him."

answers.text: Because he has offered many sacrifices
Because he has set his love on God

questions.text: With what will God satisfy him in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: "I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation."
